name: Anomaly Detection Agent
fn: Flags unusual payment patterns, potential fraud or duplicate payments
detail: Flags unusual payment patterns — duplicates, overpayments and potential fraud — using isolation forests and statistical baselines before they post. Protects cash and prevents costly reversals.
sap: SAP FI-AR (open items, F-28 / F-32 clearing) · FI-BL bank statements (FF67, BAI2 / MT940) · BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_POST

io.in: Remittances · bank files (BAI2/MT940) · FI-AR open items
